samples.What does verifying a VMR record prove?: That the record was signed, over exactly these bytes, by a key your trust store trusts for the issuer it names, and that nothing in it changed since.
samples.Does compliant mean the model is legally: No. Compliant means the pack's mandatory rules passed on what the record can show. It is not a legal finding and not a certification.
samples.How would I prove which data trained a m: With --training-records, the record commits to the training records by their count, a digest of the named set and a Merkle root, so any record can later be proven to be in the set.
